# Whats this template about?
This is a simple template to help you setup and manage your docker service stacks with lesser overhead of commands
just run the bash scripts and input the details you should be good to go

# setup?
1. Fork this template repository and use it to setup your server repo
2. after creating the servers repo, go to the actions tab and run the template-setup workflow with needed details
3. login to the server ssh and setup the server repository
4. run the scripts/setup.sh script
5. done
